headings.usage: Headers, labels, structural UI text, component titles.

data_and_numerics.usage: CRITICAL: Used for all prices, sizes, timestamps, order book data, trade tape, and real-time feeds.

spacing_and_density.philosophy: High-density Mode B (Dashboard). Maximize screen real estate. Information clarity over decorative spacing.
spacing_and_density.panels: p-3 or p-4 maximum for panel interiors.
spacing_and_density.rows: py-0.5 px-2 for order book and trade tape rows. Minimal height for maximum data display.
spacing_and_density.gaps: Use 1px gaps (gap-px) combined with bg-border on wrappers to create crisp 1px borders between panels.

grid_and_layout.wrapper: h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#27272A] (acts as border color) text-white flex flex-col
grid_and_layout.header: h-14 flex items-center px-4 justify-between bg-[#0C0C0C] shrink-0 border-b border-[#27272A]

areas.chart: col-span-12 lg:col-span-9 bg-[#0C0C0C] flex flex-col h-[50vh] lg:h-auto
areas.order_book: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 bg-[#0C0C0C] h-[40vh] lg:h-full overflow-hidden flex flex-col
areas.trade_tape: col-span-12 lg:col-span-9 bg-[#0C0C0C] h-[30vh] lg:h-[35%] flex flex-col

surface_and_borders.style: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeleton, sharp edges, cardless.
rules: No drop shadows. Use flat surfaces.
1px solid borders between all adjacent panels (achieved via grid gap-px and wrapper background).
Panels are completely flat. UI components should use sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm) edges.

components.file_extension: All components and logic MUST be written in standard Javascript/JSX (.js files).

market_selector.styling: Solid dark background (CRITICAL: NO transparent bg). Borderless trigger, font-mono for mid-price display.
market_selector.features: Include connection status indicator (green dot for live WebSocket).

chart.styling: Dark theme configuration injected via library config. Candlesticks colored matching market.bid_text and market.ask_text.
chart.controls: Include 1s/5s interval toggle inside the chart panel header.

order_book.layout: Split view in the right column (asks top, bids bottom).
features: Depth Bars: Absolute positioned divs with width percentages behind the rows.
Spread Row: Centered between bids and asks with contrasting background.
Alignment: Tabular numbers right-aligned to align decimals perfectly.

trade_tape.layout: Scrolling data grid at the bottom under the chart.
trade_tape.styling: Columns: Timestamp, Symbol, Side, Size, Price. Sticky header, scrollable body.
trade_tape.features: New rows flash briefly upon insertion.

stress_test_drawer.styling: Anchored to the right. Use solid bg-[#121212]. Include Toggles for volatility and Action buttons for spikes.
stress_test_drawer.buttons: Sharp edged, solid colors. Red for spike down, Green for spike up.

toasts.styling: Dark theme, positioned top-right or bottom-right, distinct border color based on event type (volatility changed, spike).

motion_and_interactions.price_flashes: Backgrounds of changed cells flash bid_bg_flash or ask_bg_flash for 300ms upon data change, then transition back to transparent.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use 'transition-colors duration-300 ease-out' for flashes. CRITICAL: No layout shifts on updates.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hovering over rows in order book/trade tape highlights the row with bg-[#171717].

icons_and_assets.usage: Use sparingly for controls (settings, chart intervals, connection status). CRITICAL: No emojis.

universal_guidelines: No generic AI slop. Create a dense, highly professional, hyper-functional terminal.
CRITICAL: Use pure React state/refs for high frequency updates, avoid heavy re-renders. Use tabular-nums class for all numbers to prevent horizontal jitter.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or drawers.
Use standard DOM elements with Tailwind classes for grid layouts to avoid Shadcn structural limitations in dense environments.
Focus on performance: ensure chart and order book can handle heavy event loads without freezing.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: CRITICAL: ALL interactive elements, buttons, toggles, dropdowns, and data rows MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="market-selector"', 'data-testid="orderbook-bid-row"').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Maintain strictly >4.5:1 contrast for all essential text against dark backgrounds.
